name: System Diagnostics
author: angelherman
description: Complete read-only system health diagnostic with quick/full scans. Detects errors in Omarchy, Arch, systemd, the journal, storage, packages, security, network and graphics. Produces AI-ready reports and can send them to your default Omarchy AI agent.

barWidget.description: Traffic-light health indicator. Click for quick/full diagnostic scans, with AI-ready reports.
